title: 75 FS pilot flies A-10 No. 995, one year after successful emergency landing
description:
U.S. Air Force Capt. Taylor Bye, 75th Fighter Squadron pilot, flies A-10C Thunderbolt II, tail No. 995, on Nov. 3, 2021, for the first time since an emergency belly landing at Moody Air Force Base, Georgia, in 2020.

Maintainers from the 75th Aircraft Maintenance Unit successfully restored the aircraft which received extensive damage from the crash landing.
keywords: ACC, 75th FS, 23rd Wing, crash landing, 995, Lead Wing
